correctness.rationale: Heredity permits half-plane-selected subsets; averaging nonnegative rotated real parts gives exactly \(1/\pi\) times the absolute coefficient sum. Contractivity and density extend the estimate. For sharpness, every subset sum of equally spaced roots is bounded by a consecutive semicircle block with modulus at most \(1/\sin(\pi/m)\), so the distortion lower bound \(m\sin(\pi/m)\) tends to \(\pi\). The norm-one upper bound is witnessed by basis vectors. No finite experiment is used as proof.
